name: Analytic Transmittance 3DGS
definition: A rasterization-based rendering method that replaces the approximate alpha computation of 3DGS with an analytic integration of the volume rendering equation along the camera ray, computing physically accurate transmittance and alpha values without projecting 3D Gaussians to 2D (splatting).
summary: Analytic Transmittance 3DGS is a volumetrically consistent rendering method that computes exact transmittance by integrating 3D Gaussians directly in ray-space, avoiding the linearization errors of standard splatting.
